js: 'The Chat follows the end of the transcript through every growth while the reader is at it, and leaves a reader who scrolled up where they are: a picture call\'s live pane taller than the follow\'s 120 px, the picture replacing it, a re-roll\'s pane and strip, a spoken result\'s player, a scroll up the page made while the transcript grew (what WebKitGTK did as a live pane mounted), then a picture and a re-roll landing with the reader scrolled up 300 px (not pulled toward the end; WebKitGTK on a real frame clock drops such a reader about 42 px up as the live pane gives way to the card, with or without the follow), and the follow back once they return to the end. Each check waits for the pane to settle (5 frames unchanged) and reads gap = scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight. Run: scripts/chat-media-drive.sh --drive scripts/drive/chat-follow.json --tools scripts/drive/chat-follow.tools.json [--chrome] [--webkit] [--kwin] (it fills in the thread id and the helpers of scripts/drive/chat-media.js and chat-follow.js).'
